description:
Has anything changed around where I am going since my last trip or since a date: a fee, a leash rule, a closure?
Re-checks a saved itinerary or a destination: one area, one place or one stretch of highway.
Inputs: place (city, county, neighborhood, area or region: "Tahoe", "Alameda", "Monterey") or near={lat, lon}, with radius_miles; or place_id for one place; or route (i-5, us-101, highway-1 ...) with from_mile and to_mile for the listed stops on that stretch. since as YYYY-MM-DD; optional outcome (confirmed, changed, source_gone, blocked, disputed).
Returns verification events for places in scope, newest first, each with the place, outcome, date and record link, the rule-change log entries for them, and on the hosted server a separate corrections list (corrections filed for those places or decided since the date, by ticket id and status). An empty list means nothing was re-checked or changed in that window; an unknown name is an answer with did_you_mean.

Example: "What changed near Monterey since September?" -> place="Monterey", since="2026-09-01"

from_mile.description: With route: start of the stretch, in route miles

near.description: A point as an alternative to a town: one of place or near

place.description: A city, county, area, region, neighborhood or airport in California or Nevada, e.g. "Monterey", "South Lake Tahoe", "Washoe County, NV", "Las Vegas", "East Bay", "Lake Tahoe", "Central Valley", "Van Nuys", "Koreatown", "Venice Beach", "the Mission", "DTLA", "SFO" or "LAX airport" (an airport searches 5 miles unless radius_miles is given). Accepts the place as people say it; small spelling slips ("Montery") are corrected and the answer says so.

place_id.description: One place by its id from any answer, e.g. "carmel-beach": changes for that place alone

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around the town or point (an area is its own boundary; the radius is ignored)

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

route.description: A highway, e.g. "i-5", "us-101", "highway-1" or "i-80-nevada": changes at the listed stops on that highway

to_mile.description: With route: end of the stretch, in route miles

name: dogpolicies_changes_near

accepted.description: With bad_input: each argument that could not be read, with the values it accepts

code.description: With an outcome other than ok: not_found, invalid, unavailable

corrections.description: Corrections people filed or whose status changed in the window (the hosted server only), newest first

reason.description: For a rejection: not_supported_by_source, duplicate, out_of_scope, could_not_verify or spam

corrections_note.description: Why corrections is empty when this server cannot list them

did_you_mean.description: Close matches to what was asked for: towns, places, slugs or brands, best first

nearest.description: When nothing is inside the radius: the nearest places in the data, with distance_miles

next.description: Calls that would answer the question, in words

outcome.description: Absent or ok: a normal answer. no_match: nothing in the data matches, see did_you_mean, nearest and next. bad_input: the arguments cannot be used as given, see next. partial: some of the ids were found, see missing. unavailable: a live source could not be read. None of these is an error.

page_url.description: The page for the scope: the place's record or the road-trip guide

resolved_from.description: Set when a word was read as the value the tool uses: hotel as lodging, NB as north. Each key is the argument; asked is what was sent, used what it was read as

rule_changes.description: The rule-change log for places in scope (and the chain of a hotel in scope) since the date

scope_kind.description: What the scope is: a town or county with a radius, an area's own places, a point, one place, or a highway's stops

title: What changed near a town
